characters.name: JÄNES JUKU
characters.description: Väike hall jänes suurte pikkade kõrvadega, kandmas väikest sinist vesti, uudishimulikud ja sõbralikud silmad. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: SIIL SASS
characters.description: Väike pruun siil ümarate okastega, kandmas väikest punast salli, armsad väikesed silmad ja rõõmus naeratus. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Päikeseline Tiigiäär
locations.description: A sunny forest clearing with a small, calm pond. The pond has clear, blue water. The ground is covered with soft green grass and some smooth, colourful stones scattered around. Tall green trees surround the clearing. Bright cheerful sunlight. Cartoon style.

pages.scene: Jänes Juku stands at the edge of a calm, clear blue pond in a sunny forest clearing. He is looking at the water with a curious expression. The ground is green grass with some colourful stones. Tall green trees surround the clearing. Bright cheerful sunlight. Cute cartoon style.

Jänes Juku stands at the edge of a calm, clear blue pond. Siil Sass stands next to him, looking at the pond. Both have curious and friendly expressions. The ground is green grass with some colourful stones. Tall green trees surround the clearing. Bright cheerful sunlight. Cute cartoon style.

Jänes Juku and Siil Sass are kneeling on the soft green grass at the edge of the pond. They are pointing at various smooth, colourful stones scattered on the ground. Both have excited and curious expressions. Tall green trees surround the clearing. Bright cheerful sunlight. Cute cartoon style.

Jänes Juku and Siil Sass are sitting on the green grass near the pond, closely examining several smooth, shiny, colourful stones they have picked up. They are holding the stones in their paws/hands, smiling. Tall green trees surround the clearing. Bright cheerful sunlight. Cute cartoon style.

Jänes Juku and Siil Sass are actively moving around on the green grass near the pond, bending down to pick up more smooth, colourful stones. Juku holds a small pile of stones, and Sass is putting stones into a small, simple basket. Both are focused and happy. Tall green trees surround the clearing. Bright cheerful sunlight. Cute cartoon style.

Jänes Juku and Siil Sass are sitting on the green grass near the pond. They have a collection of colourful stones laid out in front of them, sorted into small groups by color or size. They are carefully arranging the piles, looking thoughtful. Tall green trees surround the clearing. Bright cheerful sunlight. Cute cartoon style.

Jänes Juku and Siil Sass are kneeling on the green grass near the pond. They are carefully placing the colourful, sorted stones on the ground to form a simple, geometric pattern. A part of the pattern is already visible. They are working together, concentrating. Tall green trees surround the clearing. Bright cheerful sunlight. Cute cartoon style.

Jänes Juku and Siil Sass are standing back a little from their almost completed large, beautiful pattern made of colourful stones on the green grass. The pattern now covers a significant area. They are admiring their work, smiling proudly. Tall green trees surround the clearing. Bright cheerful sunlight. Cute cartoon style.

Jänes Juku and Siil Sass are sitting happily beside their fully completed, intricate and beautiful pattern made of colourful stones on the green grass. The pattern is clearly visible and looks vibrant. They are admiring it with satisfied expressions. Tall green trees surround the clearing. Bright cheerful sunlight. Cute cartoon style.

Jänes Juku and Siil Sass are joyfully celebrating next to their finished colourful stone pattern on the green grass by the pond. They are jumping slightly or clapping their paws, looking very happy and proud of their creation. Tall green trees surround the clearing. Bright cheerful sunlight. Cute cartoon style.
